reading: Joined by the term Products, a reading: Zid's API group Merchant APIs > Products > Managing Products (ZD-S-0914) and its plan line Add Products / إضافة منتجات (ZD-S-0915) name the same object as Shopify's Products (SH-S-1509), Salla's Merchant API folder Products (SA-S-1022) and WooCommerce's Products menu (WC-S-0049). Like SH-C-020 and WC-C-064, ZD-C-083 is coarse: Q1 placed in it Zid's API groups for brands, attributes, variants, images and badges and its product plan lines, so its sub-parts are cited in the children of CM-CAT-001 (CM-CAT-002, CM-CAT-005, CM-CAT-007, CM-CAT-013, CM-CAT-014, CM-CAT-015), all in CM-CAT-001's tree.

Joined by the term, a reading: Zid's Product Categories / تصنيف المنتجات, its API group (ZD-S-0009) and plan line, 'Organize your products easily by category' (ZD-S-0917), are Salla's plan line تصنيفات المنتجات (SA-S-1974) and Merchant API folder Categories (SA-S-1053) and WooCommerce's Products > Categories (WC-S-0052). Shopify's Collections are in the capability by the anchor's join on role.

Joined by the term Inventory Management / إدارة المخزون, a reading: Zid's plan line, 'Monitor and classify your inventory effectively' (ZD-S-0918), is Salla's plan line إدارة المخزون (SA-S-1976) and Shopify's plan row Inventory management (SH-S-7009). ZD-C-085 is coarse: it holds Zid's inventory locations, warehouses and their plan limits too, with its API group Inventories (ZD-S-0023, ZD-S-0100, ZD-S-0493, ZD-S-0372, ZD-S-1021, ZD-S-1022, ZD-S-1024, ZD-S-0920), which are cited in CM-INV-005, a capability outside CM-INV-001's tree (the anchor made locations a root, not a child of inventory tracking), so the fit is strained. Its other parts are in CM-INV-001's children (CM-INV-002, CM-INV-003, CM-INV-006, CM-INV-009, CM-INV-010).

Joined by the terms, a reading: Zid's Digital Products / المنتجات الرقمية, its API group with Create Downloadable Product (ZD-S-0022) and its digital products (المنتجات الرقمية, ZD-S-0590), are Salla's Digitals Product folder (SA-S-1029) and plan line إرسال محتوى المنتجات الرقمية (SA-S-1999), and WooCommerce's Downloadable products (WC-S-0014). Zid's Digital Vouchers (ZD-S-0008) are read as the digital codes the capability's name holds, a reading: no statement defines a voucher.
